title: HOW TO PLAY PICK YOUR BET

sections.text:
PURCHASE YOUR TICKET

There are three bet types to choose from: Lucky Number, Odd or Even, and Low or High.

To let the computer randomly select your bet for you, choose a Quick Pick on the vending machine for the bet option you would like, or tell the cashier you want a Quick Pick at the time of your purchase.
To choose your own bet, go to the vending machine or tell the cashier which bet option you would like. There are no play slips for Quick Draw games.

You can play up to ten times on a single ticket.

Select your wager - $2, $4, $6, $10, or $20 per play.

A Lucky Number wager of $2 gives you a chance to win up to $50 and a Lucky Number wager of $20 gives you a chance to win up to $500.

You can choose to play for one drawing up to fifteen consecutive drawings.

Then, your ticket will print with your bet option on it.

 

INCREASE YOUR PRIZES WITH SUPER BONUS

When you play Pick Your Bet you can add on Super Bonus for the same cost as your base wager.

Adding Super Bonus gives you a chance to multiply your prize by 1X, 2X, 3X, 4X, or 5X. At the very end of the drawing, a multiplier will be selected and will apply to any Pick Your Bet prize you win in that drawing.

 

HOW TO WIN

During the hourly drawing1, one number2 will be selected from 1 - 38. Match the bet on your ticket to the Pick Your Bet drawing result to win.

 

HOW TO CHECK WINNING NUMBERS

You can watch the hourly drawings on the Players Club app or online at ArizonaLottery.com.

You can also check your tickets by scanning them on the Players Club app or a ticket checker at an Arizona Lottery retailer.

 

ABOUT WINNING
HOW TO CLAIM YOUR WINNINGS

All Arizona Lottery retailers will redeem prizes up to $100, and may redeem prizes up to $599. See full details about How to Claim Prizes.

 

PICK YOUR BET FAQS
WHAT ARE THE ODDS OF WINNING A PRIZE ON PICK YOUR BET?

Overall odds of winning a prize varies upon the bet type selected.

WHEN ARE PICK YOUR BET DRAWINGS HELD?

Drawings are held daily every 60 minutes. The first draw of the day is at 4:40 AM Arizona time and the last draw is at 11:40 PM Arizona time.

HOW OFTEN CAN I PLAY MY NUMBERS?

You can play for up to 15 consecutive drawing dates on the same ticket. Just tell the cashier at the time of your purchase or select the Multi Draw box on the vending machine.

HOW LONG DO I HAVE TO CLAIM A TWO TO WIN PRIZE?

You have 180 days from the date of the drawing to claim a prize. Once a ticket has expired, it cannot be redeemed even if it is a winner.

WHERE DO I FIND THE DRAW ID?

Draw IDs appear on each Quick Draw ticket purchased in the bottom right-hand corner. If you purchased a ticket for more than one drawing, a range of Draw IDs will be included on the ticket. For Example: DRAW ID 10001 or, DRAW ID 10001 THRU DRAW ID 10015

 

DISCLAIMERS

1 Pick Your Bet can be played from 4:00 AM to 11:59 PM Arizona time, seven days a week, with the first draw time at 4:40 AM Arizona time and the last drawing at 11:40 PM Arizona time.

2 Lottery numbers broadcasted on television or radio, published on the Arizona State Lottery website, or published and/or communicated by other means does not constitute an official representation of the actual winning lottery numbers. The Arizona State Lottery official audited records of numbers drawn will determine the winning numbers for any draw. A draw game prize must be claimed within 180 days of a drawing.

3 All sales are final. Drawing game tickets cannot be voided.
